Q5028.reason: The recorded plan restricting the 10-acre lot to school use, relied on by lot buyers under a common scheme, is best described as a restrictive covenant.

Q5787.reason: The defendant meant only to wound, so the death of his own teammate is most plausibly involuntary manslaughter (reckless or unlawful-act killing) rather than murder.

Q5115.reason: Lactate is produced continuously and rises when glycolytic flux outpaces oxidation, which can happen even with oxygen available, so A fits better than B.
